note: Cola followup pack is the merge bar for concurrency/recovery. Soft in-repo pr4r2 tests are not sufficient. Do not weaken B01/B09/B10/G05.

findings.title: apply(batchId) must write the consumed receipt snapshot, not a fresh worktree capture
findings.observed: After issuing receipt for APPROVED_A, a ledger.consume persist hook swaps the worktree to NOT_ACCEPTED_B and issues an unconsumed B receipt. reg.apply(batchId) then writes B because apply recaptures the mutable worktree. Soft Service approvedChangeset is not enough.
findings.fix: Pin an immutable FrozenChangeset by diffHash when hashing/issuing/consuming. apply(batchId) after consume uses that approved pin. Distinct proposals are distinct hashes. Project command queue.

findings.title: MAIN_SNAPSHOT must not clobber BATCH_WORK
findings.acceptance: Checkpoint carries worktree identity. Restore writes only to the snapshot worktree (or refuses cross-worktree). Validate the full restore plan before moving the cursor.

findings.title: Binary mid-history checkpoint 81 00 must restore 81 00
findings.acceptance: captureSourceFiles stores binary mid-history bytes/hashes. Rewind does not fall back to the first baseline 80 00.

findings.title: Hashed journal USER_REPAIR is quietly preserved
findings.acceptance: Hashed write journal + USER_REPAIR (distinct from before/after hashes) → recover keeps USER_REPAIR without restoring the backup. Truncated half-write (AGE vs AGENT_FULL) stays BLOCKED. Those are different outcomes.
